## Import and load necessary packages


## Distance Matrix and Principal Component Analysis

```{r}

dists <- DistanceMatrix(aligned, type = "matrix", correction = "Poisson") #DECIPHER
View(dists) ##Create distance matrix with Poisson correction method
class(dists)

max_dist <- max(dists, na.rm = TRUE)
print(max_dist)

write.csv(dists, "dists.csv")

##Perform Principal Component Analysis - base R
pca_result <- prcomp(dists, scale. = TRUE)

# Create a data frame from PCA results
pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_result$x[,1],
  PC2 = pca_result$x[,2],
  Label = rownames(dists) 
)
class(pca_df)

# Plot using ggplot2
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Label)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.3, max.overlaps = 50) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA of Sequence Distances",
       x = "PC1", y = "PC2")

summary(pca_result)
head(pca_result$x)

```

##Phylogenetic Tree 

```{r} 

set.seed(42)

tree_upgma <- upgma(dists)
plot(tree_upgma, main = "UPGMA Phylogenetic Tree")

bootstrap_trees <- boot.phylo(tree_upgma, dists, FUN = function(xx) upgma(dist.aa(xx)), B = 100, trees = TRUE)
print(bootstrap_trees) ##Run bootstrapping of the tree w given distance matrix using 100 iterations and UPGMA formula

consensus_tree <- consensus(bootstrap_trees$trees, p = 0.39, check.labels = TRUE, rooted = TRUE)
consensus_tree <- addConfidences(consensus_tree, bootstrap_trees$trees)

# Add to plot
plot(consensus_tree, main="Bootstrap Consensus Tree- UPGMA", type="phylogram", cex = 0.8, cex.lab = 1.5, show.tip.label = TRUE)
nodelabels(consensus_tree$node.label, frame = "none", cex = 0.8, cex.lab = 1.5, col = "red")

tree_nj <- nj(dists)
plot(tree_nj, main = "Neighbor Joining Phylogenetic Tree")

nj_bootstrap_trees <- boot.phylo(tree_nj, dists, FUN = function(xx) nj(dist.aa(xx)), B = 100, trees = TRUE)
print(nj_bootstrap_trees) ##Run bootstrapping of the tree w given distance matrix using 100 iterations and UPGMA formula

nj_consensus_tree <- consensus(nj_bootstrap_trees$trees, p = 0.45, check.labels = TRUE, rooted = FALSE)
nj_consensus_tree <- addConfidences(nj_consensus_tree, nj_bootstrap_trees$trees)

# Add to plot
plot(nj_consensus_tree, main="Bootstrap Consensus Tree- Neighbor-Joining", type="phylogram", cex = 0.8, cex.lab = 1.5, show.tip.label = TRUE)
nodelabels(nj_consensus_tree$node.label, frame = "none", cex = 0.8, cex.lab = 1.5, col = "red")

```

##GC Content Analysis

```{r}

dna_sequences <- readDNAStringSet("C:\\Users\\sophi\\OneDrive\\Documents\\ClassAssignments\\BIOL4815\\projectfastadnaseq.txt")
  print(dna_sequences)
gc_content <- letterFrequency(dna_sequences, letters = c("G", "C"), as.prob=TRUE)
gc_total <- rowSums(gc_content)
print(gc_total)
summary(gc_total)

max_gc <- which.max(gc_total)
cat("Highest GC content is in ", names(dna_sequences)[max_gc])

dna_prokaryotic <- readDNAStringSet("C:\\Users\\sophi\\OneDrive\\Documents\\ClassAssignments\\BIOL4815\\dna_prokaryotic.txt")
dna_eukaryotic <- readDNAStringSet("C:\\Users\\sophi\\OneDrive\\Documents\\ClassAssignments\\BIOL4815\\dna_eukaryotic.txt")

gc_prok <- rowSums(letterFrequency(dna_prokaryotic, c("G", "C"), as.prob=TRUE)) * 100
gc_euk <- rowSums(letterFrequency(dna_eukaryotic, c("G", "C"), as.prob=TRUE)) * 100

gc_data <- data.frame(
  GC_Content = c(gc_prok, gc_euk),
  Group = c(rep("Prokaryotes", length(gc_prok)), rep("Eukaryotes", length(gc_euk)))
)

ggplot(gc_data, aes(x=Group, y=GC_Content, fill=Group)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100))+  # Y-axis from 0 to 1

  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title="GC Content Comparison", y="GC Content (%)") 

t.test(gc_prok, gc_euk)

```


## Codon Usage Bias

```{r}

cds_prokaryotic <- readDNAStringSet("C:\\Users\\sophi\\OneDrive\\Documents\\ClassAssignments\\BIOL4815\\cds_prokaryotic.txt")
seq_prokaryotic <- as.character(cds_prokaryotic)

cds_eukaryotic <-  readDNAStringSet("C:\\Users\\sophi\\OneDrive\\Documents\\ClassAssignments\\BIOL4815\\cds_eukaryotic.txt")
seq_eukaryotic <- as.character(cds_eukaryotic)

# Function to clean sequences
clean_seqs <- function(seqs) {
  seqs <- toupper(seqs)
  seqs <- seqs[nchar(seqs) %% 3 == 0]  # Keep sequences with length divisible by 3
  return(seqs)
}

# Clean sequences
seqs_prok_clean <- clean_seqs(seq_prokaryotic)
seqs_euk_clean  <- clean_seqs(seq_eukaryotic)

codon_prok <- count_codons(seqs_prok_clean)
codon_euk <- count_codons(seqs_euk_clean)

rscu_prok <- est_rscu(codon_prok)
rscu_euk  <- est_rscu(codon_euk)

# Merge RSCU data frames
rscu_combined <- merge(rscu_prok, rscu_euk, by = "codon", suffixes = c("_prok", "_euk"))

ggplot(rscu_combined, aes(x = rscu_prok, y = rscu_euk, label = codon)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue") +
  geom_text(size = 2, vjust = -0.7) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Relative Synonymous Codon Usage, Thermophilic Prokaryotes and Mesophilic Eukaryotes",
       x = "Prokaryotes RSCU",
       y = "Eukaryotes RSCU") +
  theme_minimal()

```
